title: Licensing and entitlements
status: gate met - signed licence, two gates, expiry/grace with write blocking, licence page and shell banner; seat limits read but not enforced

implementation.headless: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Headless/OgHeadlessRunner.cs (--licence-check verifies; --entitlement-report prints licence and write state)
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/LicensingTests.cs (13), TestLicences.cs, HeadlessVerbTests.cs (licence verbs), SourceGuardTests.cs (no private key under src)

processRuns.evidence: signature: verified (key dev-2026); edition Professional; customer Probe Energy; modules core,data,wells,administration; expires 2030-12-31; usable True; result: verified-ok
signature: not verified - licence-signature-invalid; problem: the signature does not match its contents; result: refused
signature: not verified - licence-unsigned; problem: not signed, contents cannot be authenticated; result: refused

entitlement-service OgLicenceService; licence-enforcement Permissive; licence-status 'No licence is installed. Enforcement is off, so every module is available.'; module: wells = allowed | write=allowed; page: wells ... open=True

gates.AC-1 a module is available only when bot: pass - OgNavigationService asks the entitlement first and then the role. An_entitled_module_still_needs_the_role proves a granted module is denied with only the Viewer role and allowed with SystemAdmin; A_module_the_licence_does_not_grant_is_denied_even_for_an_administrator proves the reverse direction.
gates.AC-2 an expired licence blocks writes an: pass - An_expired_licence_past_grace_allows_reads_and_blocks_writes_when_enforced: Allows(wells) true, AllowsWriting(wells) false, AllowsWriting(core) true. The smoke run asserts the same projection with a clock ten years ahead. The shell banner shows the status sentence when expired, in grace, or unlicensed under enforcement.
gates.AC-3 an invalid signature is treated as: pass - An_altered_payload_is_treated_as_unlicensed_with_a_stated_reason and A_licence_signed_by_a_key_this_build_does_not_trust_is_refused return licence-signature-invalid / licence-key-unknown and IsLicensed false; the process run exits 2 with the same code and no exception text.
gates.AC-4 the entitlement report lists editio: pass - the sample's payload and the report agree field for field (Professional / Probe Energy / core,data,wells,administration); the smoke run reads the same values after Import.
gates.AC-5 a licence never contains a plaintex: pass - the format has four fields (schema, keyId, payload, signature) and no secret field; A_licence_carries_no_secret_and_the_trusted_keys_are_public_only asserts the field names, the absence of PRIVATE KEY/password/secret/token, and that every embedded trust anchor is a PUBLIC KEY.
gates.AC-6 changing a licence takes effect wit: pass - Importing_a_valid_licence_takes_effect_without_a_restart imports into the same service instance and reads the new customer immediately; the service raises Changed and the shell rebuilds navigation and banner. Importing_a_tampered_licence_is_refused_and_leaves_the_installed_one_intact proves a bad import cannot degrade a working install.

security.signedBytes: the decoded payload verbatim; no serializer in the trust path
security.trustAnchor: embedded resource, not a file under the data root
security.privateKey: development key only, in the test project's Fixtures folder; guard No_private_key_material_is_committed_under_src fails the build if any file under src contains PRIVATE KEY
security.releaseAction: replace Security/licence-keys.json with the production vendor public key before release (REL-01/REL-05)

limits: Seat counts are parsed, shown and carried on the entitlement but not enforced at sign-in; the local user store keeps no active-session count.
The shell banner's visibility and text are computed from the entitlement and covered by state tests, but no screenshot or click-through exists.
The development key is the only trusted key: a production-signed licence is refused until the real key is embedded.
There is no vendor-side licence issuance tool; licences are signed outside the product.
Enforcement defaults to Permissive because the commercial terms are undecided (REL-02 §9).
